topic: Menkhoff et al. 2012 foundational CS momentum
source_and_access: BIS primary full text: https://www.bis.org/publications/working-paper-366-currency-momentum-strategies.pdf; §§3-4.1 pp.9-17; §5 pp.29-35; App Tables A.4 pp.75-76 and A.12-A.13 p.84
sample_or_universe: 48 countries total with variable availability; max cross-section below 40; 15-country developed subset
signal_or_portfolio: Six equal-count portfolios; High minus Low; f=1,3,6,9,12; separately sorted on lagged excess returns and spot changes
payoff_horizon_and_costs: h=1,3,6,9,12; quoted spot/1M forward bid-ask; one-month 1/1 High and Low turnover 74.3% and 72.2% monthly; developed net MOM(1,1) 0.79% annualized, t=0.44
regime_or_dates: Jan 1976-Jan 2010; developed subset within same sample
verified_finding: Excess return approximately forward log rate minus next spot log rate; spot changes also reported; developed subset results much smaller and largely absent after costs
relevance_to_fixed_proposal: Closest foundational match for monthly CS sorts and separated spot/excess measures; design differs from 8-currency single extreme pair
limitations_and_unverified_fields: Legacy sample/quotes, much broader cross-section, no post-2010 evidence; exact candidate pair not studied; indicative quotes described by authors as wide
